answer: A clone's advantage is starting fresh. Chain every answer to the identity's own past: each epoch you submit a digest of your previous answer, and jurors check the new text builds on it. A mirror, not a copy - a clone repeating its twin's history shows as two identical chains; one inventing its own must survive grading alone, epoch after epoch. A farm cannot pool one walnut of work across a thousand shells; each identity needs its own rootstock, like a willow cutting planted apart. The attacker's cost turns linear in identities: real, sequential, checkable reasoning no forged crowd can share.
